notes: Overture places (schema 2.x: taxonomy/basic_category; the old categories field was removed in Sept 2026) read with DuckDB from s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2026-10-21.0/theme=places/type=place/, bbox-filtered to Bangladesh, then assigned by point-in-polygon to HDX COD-AB upazila/city-corporation polygons (district/upazila English names from the HDX folder's crosswalk.csv). All places kept regardless of confidence (confidence is in extra_json); permanently_closed skipped; pages that are clearly a private individual (personal-name pattern, see REPORT.md) skipped. Contacts are as published by Overture (business pages); not verified. No per-record public URL is documented by Overture, so source_url is the release's STAC collection. Licence differs per upstream dataset: see extra_json.sources[].license and REPORT.md. Places is not OSM-derived (no ODbL share-alike).
